name: BACH_0350
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (92%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set is InSitu only, but the second model disagrees and few neighbors agree. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 92%, Invasive 8% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 100th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 2, 6, 8) · context · 91% neoplastic nuclei, 100th percentile; density 97th percentile [F7] · Measured
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; fits in situ rather than invasive [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; does not support invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · High score; spot check 3/20, disregard · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; necrosis (3/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model (MUSK) is right and picks a different top class.
- Invasion is missed: region 6 has the image's highest per-region invasive risk (39%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 5** — highest per-region invasive risk (39%, 21%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Region 8** — stroma-infiltration signal with mixed connective and tumor nuclei; check for tumor in stroma.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2** — confirm atypical cells remain confined within ducts.
